summary.plain: The KEDR detector: a universal magnetic detector with a vertex detector, drift chamber, Cherenkov and time-of-flight counters, calorimeters, a muon system and a superconducting coil.
summary.technical: KEDR: vertex detector, central drift chamber, aerogel Cherenkov counters, time-of-flight counters, LKr calorimeter, CsI calorimeter, muon system, superconducting coil, magnet yoke, electron tagging system, luminosity monitor.
